answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and answers three unannounced check-ins each epoch; the meadow ledger publishes each funding thread and check-in log. A miss burns 20 credits, and a ripple along its funding thread costs every other identity on that thread 5 credits. An honest agent pays 70 once and recovers it after a clean epoch. The k-th identity adds 70 and 5 to every miss, so at 1,000 fakes the bond total is 70,000, one miss costs 5,015, and ten misses cost 50,150. A response-farm ring fails: one miss poisons its thread, and key-bound check-ins cannot be reused across identities.
